# Shelf — full agent brief

Shelf indexes 5,306 popular anime and 2,288 popular manga for crawlable public discovery.

## Shelf — Discover anime and manga

Shelf is an anime and manga discovery app backed by MyAnimeList catalog data. Public discovery works without an account; personal watchlists and schedules require sign-in.

## Advanced anime search — Shelf

Use multi-field filters to search the anime catalog by score, year, genre, theme, demographic, popularity, airing status, and format. Search state is shareable in the HTML URL.

## Random anime picker — Shelf

The HTML route selects a random anime from the public catalog. Use advanced search when you want to constrain the pick by score, year, genre, or other catalog fields.

## Anime catalog statistics — Shelf

Explore aggregate anime catalog statistics, including distributions by score, year, format, genre, theme, demographic, membership, and favorites.

## Advanced manga search — Shelf

Search the public manga catalog with multi-field filters for score, year, genre, theme, demographic, status, format, popularity, and favorites.

## Manga catalog statistics — Shelf

Explore aggregate manga catalog statistics, including distributions by score, year, format, genre, theme, demographic, membership, and favorites.

## Anime character quiz — Shelf

The quiz maps four local answers to a viewing archetype and a prefilled public search. Answers are not persisted; analytics retain only the resulting archetype.

## Shelf changelog

The HTML changelog owns verified product releases. Catalog ingestion history is maintained separately on the catalog updates page.

## Shelf catalog updates

The HTML page shows catalog ingestion history from the public API, including the latest anime and manga refresh times and recent changes.

## About Shelf

Shelf helps people discover anime and manga with transparent multi-field filters and ranking, then track personal choices after signing in.

## Shelf privacy

Public catalog browsing does not require an account. Google sign-in and an httpOnly authentication cookie are used for personal watchlists, schedules, alerts, tokens, and collection management.

## Shelf terms

Shelf provides discovery and tracking tools without warranty. Catalog scores and metadata come from third-party sources and remain subject to their terms.

## Shelf MCP setup

Shelf exposes public MCP catalog tools for search, detail, and statistics. Watchlist tools require a revocable personal access token created after signing in.

## Authentication boundary

Public catalog pages and detail Markdown require no account. Personal watchlists, schedules, alerts, collection management, token management, and authenticated MCP tools are not public indexing surfaces.
